'''Patrick Skahill''' (GEMP handle '''Bloo_Milk''')<ref name="handle-skahill">GEMP handle: Patrick Skahill's forum name is bloo_milk (Beezer Bowl pre-registration list: "bloo_milk-------Patrick Skahill"), and "Bloo_Milk" appears among the GEMP screen names in the sealed-league invite list. Sources: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1419022#p1419022 pre-registration list], in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83879 East Hampton, Connecticut: First Annual Beezer Bowl], forum.starwarsccg.org (24 November 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013123752/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t83879.html#p1419022 Internet Archive]; [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1331827#p1331827 invite list of GEMP screen names], in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=77430 Sealed league signups], forum.starwarsccg.org.</ref> is a [[Retro League]] player on [[GEMP]]. He finished 53rd in [[2024 Retro League Event 1]].<ref name="p1422388" />
